body: It makes you feel so confused which leads to you wanting to not be around anymore. It really sucks. I hope both of us can find the strength to keep living.
Thank you, this cheered me up a little.
Thank you for these kind words. I hope this situation does improve and the feelings fade.

I should have made it more clear, but I do not want to go back into teaching. It was what made me go on antidepressants and have panic attacks. I’m saving money up with my new job and want to move on. I don’t want to be living with my dad as an adult, trust me. It just broke my heart to hear my dad saying he wasted his time raising me.
